Despite having played over 400 hours I just can't recommend this game. It is a lot of fun, especially with friends, hence the hours. The map looks nice, the bosses and caves are fun and difficult and of course you know, dinosaurs... This game is fun at first when you have nothing to lose, perhaps for the first 50 hours. However once you start making progress/get serious things take a turn.
It's very clear that the developers do not care about this game or any of the countless expansions after. All they care about is the money as they continue to release one broken half finished DLC after another. The original map should still be in beta at best. The game is disgustingly buggy/glitchy and these are not small bugs. No these are literally game crashing, game breaking bugs that make it unplayable.
If I wasn't playing on my own server with mods I'd have uninstalled a long time ago. Too many times have things glitched through the wall, dinos disappeared etc... that loses you hours sometimes days of work.

As someone that has spent over 150 hours in this game, I can honestly say it is fun. Really fun. However, there is a fatal flaw that is ruining my good time on this game. The fact that I can spend all day (literally, from 9 a.m. to 11 p.m.) building a base, taming dinos, and farming resources, then go to sleep and have everything I've worked on destroyed and my progress reverted back to nothing, is more infuriating that anything I can possibly describe. The game is designed so when you log off, your body goes unconscious wherever you logged out and your base is just sitting there, for anyone to come blow up and level. I just don't understand what I am supposed to do to stop from being griefed by people when I am not even playing the game. And no, I am not going to a PvE server. The problem isn't players killing me. The problem is players killing me and my base when I am not even online. Like, what am I supposed to do? Have people in my tribe just take shifts literally 24/7?

I can't say if I recommend it or not. Here is my experience.

- Rubberbanding no matter what I do. Not CRAZY, but its there.
- Every starter area on every official server seems to have pillars built everywhere so no new players can build lol
- I found a spot to make a smallish cabin. Still in a starter area. Random crazy spawns, like T-Rexs and Giant birds. Lost all my tamed dinos like 4xs over. Couldn't keep them alive. The knockback on the enemy dinos is the worst part. Makes fighting them on foot, without guns, almost impossible.
- Have died more in the few days I played it than I have in the thousands of hours I put into Conan.
- Taming takes forever

It's just honestly hard. Not single player friendly at all. You spend hours taming a dino, only to have a random spawned in sabertooth pack in the NOOB area, kill the damn thing. It just makes you want to quit. An so I have.

So yeah, take the review for what it is - one player's experience.

ARK is truly a game of its generation, but sadly it has suffered badly from exploiting and cheating.

If you want to play PVE and have a fun experience taming and playing with all of the creatures that Ark has to offer, then this is a fantastic game.

Sadly the PVP mechanics create a massive inventive for Real Money Trades, which has created a huge black market which incentivises cheating, exploits and all-manner of hacks. Sadly, the policing strategy from the in-game GMs is very lacking.

Last month, we lost a 2-year-old base to infinite railgun hackers that could float inside of the mesh. The architecture of the character and transfer system means there is no paper-tail for the cheaters.

I truly doubt there will be another game that matches Ark's PVP in terms of its creativity, flexibility, but it is savagely undermined by the RMT market and lack of policing.
They ruined the game with the last update, the developers are idiots who only think about money.

I've been playing this game for a hot minute now and I have very few complaints overall. If you love dinosaurs and have always wanted the opportunity to tame and ride one then this is for sure the game for you. The only thing that throws me out of it a little bit is the fact that there's a pretty decent technology jump once you get to a certain point which isn't necessarily a bad thing; I just tend to prefer low tech survival games. They do manage to resolve this by adding Primitive + which I highly recommend getting if you want to limit and challenge yourself in other ways.
Very fun, but only if you like a survival experience. If you don't, then find another game. But, overall, I would definitely recommend this game to most people.

Dinos, Dinos everywhere. What is not to love. Even though the Early Access DLC is a bit hard to swallow, the dev still adds content to the game. Maybe if they cleaned up some of the nagging bugs it would be nice, but you couldnt ask for a more active dev.

This game is pure crack. So many ways to play, do you want to be a builder, do you want to hunt and tame dinosaurs, breed dinosaurs, just explore. Its all there. All the while you are on a razors edge as you can die at any time no matter how safe things appear. Rich environments. Early, mid and high level content. This game has it all

ARK is so sad because the theory behind it is nearly everything I want in a game. The exploration is fun, most everything is tamable as a mount or pet, multiplayer, PVE or PVP, etc. And I have genuinely enjoyed playing the game in some ways.

HOWEVER:
As many big developers have been doing recently, they launched the game in early development, and a lot of actual gameplay hasnt changed since. There's new dinos, new maps, hell a NEW GAME, but they haven't polished some of the most frustrating and disappointing aspects of the game since day 1. The hit boxes are abysmal, animations are a let down, you can get stuck in cracks and crevices, almost everyone installs mods and changes settings drastically to make the game very playable, ESPECIALLY outside of PVP. Instead of releasing new money grab content it would be nice to see work put into making the game feel higher quality, be better optimized, and feel like a smoother, more immersive experience. They were so close but I wish someone else could take the IP and make it feel like a good quality game. I've stopped buying all of their products because its the same disappointment every time.
